d.ko: The Book of Yog is a 3D idle RPG game presented with a Cel-Shading art style. You can rally heroes, develop the kingdom and explore the secrets of a lost world. Dozens of heroes, hundreds of skills, thousands of loot for you to combine freely. Come to embark on a journey to build the strongest team!

d.zh: 《依盖之书》是一款3D免费挂机游戏，采用卡通渲染风格来呈现的作品。踏上讨伐上古邪物之旅，召唤你的英雄，发展你的王国，探寻失落时代的真正秘密。数十英雄，百种技能，上千装备，自由组合，快来组建只属于你的最强战队！
